title: Linear – Issue tracking is dead
description: Linear's 'Issue tracking is dead' subpage is a bold marketing statement with a striking dark theme. Uses massive typography with dramatic size contrast — a provocative headline fills the viewport. Minimal layout that centers everything on the core message. Scroll-triggered text reveals and parallax effects create an immersive reading experience. No traditional navigation — just pure focused messaging that takes you on a narrative journey. The page is an excellent example of conviction-driven design where the layout, typography, and animations all serve a single provocative argument. The color palette uses Linear's signature cyan-green accent sparingly against deep dark backgrounds.
primary_use_case: Live design inspiration for conviction-driven brand pages and narrative marketing where the design must amplify a provocative argument.
style_vibe: Bold conviction-driven dark page with oversized typography, scroll reveals, and focused narrative design — no distractions, pure message.
